status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; read by scripts/contracts/contract.sh and the module's command. Format: docs/records/design-reviews/io-contract-modules.md > 5.
goal: The acceptance criteria the cycle works to: the analysis report's criteria with every settled acceptance-criterion decision applied (Q5).

decisions.note: The [ac-decision] entries of docs/decision-ledger.md > Decision-point entries, the standing ones applied in ledger order: an entry a later one names on a Supersedes line (or an Overrides line, which an earlier ledger may carry) is not applied (ibid., Replacement is explicit); standing entries on one AC id whose conclusions differ, none naming another, are a conflict that refuses the run. Who wrote an entry is not read: every entry has the same effect, and an identifier is any capital letter and number. AC and Disposition are today's lines; Text and Into are the lines Q5 adds, so that a script can apply the decision — sub-issue 3 adds them to the grammar.

AC.note: the criterion the decision is on; for added, the id it takes

Disposition.note: the operation a script applies — a value a device reads, not a classification of a judgment

Into.note: one line per criterion the split makes: "- Into: <id> — <text>"

Supersedes.note: on an entry that replaces an earlier [ac-decision] entry: its identifier

Overrides.note: an earlier ledger's line, read as Supersedes

applied_criteria.note: criteria: the criteria as applied, in order; applied: the identifiers of the entries applied, in order
